meta.title: A vendor who already participated cannot be removed
gaps: Establish the required submitted bid from vendor B: the fixed prepared state is live without a bid, and place_bid is unavailable.
Attempt removal of B: no participant-removal domain step or confirmed removal control is supplied; Remove Bid is not participant removal.
Assert the removal refusal message, "You cannot remove a vendor who has already participated", after an actual removal attempt.
Assert that B's bid remains counted after refusal: the prepared event contains no bid to preserve.

plan.title: Refuse removal of a participating vendor

steps.note: Open the required prepared event's Participants screen.
Record the available participant controls for inspection; this is evidence capture, not an assertion of removal refusal or bid preservation.
